import os,re,numpy as np,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def f(in_):
    A=np.array(in_); H,W=A.shape; out=A.copy()
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=int(A[r][c])
            if v==0: continue
            # check if this cell is part of a solid run >=2 in some direction
            hr=c-1>=0 and c+1<W and A[r][c-1]==v and A[r][c+1]==v
            vr=r-1>=0 and r+1<H and A[r-1][c]==v and A[r+1][c]==v
            if not(hr or vr):
                # collect candidates: horizontal run length, vertical run length, neighbors
                hor=sum(1 for k in range(W) if k!=c and A[r][k]==v and all(A[r][j]==v for j in (k-1,k+1)) and j<k)
                ver=sum(1 for k in range(H) if k!=r and A[k][c]==v and all(A[j][c]==v for j in (k-1,k+1)) and j<k)
                # simpler: longest consecutive run through this cell in each dir
                lo,hi=r; while lo>0 and A[lo-1][c]==v: lo-=1
                hi2=hi; while hi<H-1 and A[hi+1][c]==v: hi+=1
                lr=hi-lo+1
                lo,hi=c; while lo>0 and A[r][lo-1]==v: lo-=1
                hi2=hi; while hi<W-1 and A[r][hi+1]==v: hi+=1
                lc=hi-lo+1
                cand={}
                if lr>=2: cand['vert']=v
                if lc>=2: cand['horiz']=v
                for dr in(-1,0,1):
                    for dc in(-1,0,1):
                        rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                        if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W and A[rr][cc]!=v: cand[int(A[rr][cc])]=cand.get(int(A[rr][cc]),0)+1
                if not cand: continue
                # prefer existing-run extension? just pick max vote among neighbors
                best=max(cand.items(), key=lambda kv:(kv[1],kv[0]))
                out[r][c]=best[0]
    return out.tolist()
for i in range(1,9):
    pred=f(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); b=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
